import Root from "./2Managing State/4ExtratingState"
import {FullConcept as Fundamental} from "./2Managing State/4zBaseConcept"
import Sub from "./subReLearn"
import Custom from "./customComponent"
import "./ReLearn.css"
import { useReducer } from "react"

export default function () {
  const [value, dispatch] = useReducer(handleInput, "gaxorr")
  function handleChange(e) {dispatch({type:"input",el: e})}
  return <>
  <input value={value} onChange={handleChange}/>
  </>
}
